interpretation.protocol_objects: Only request, input_host_response, expect.public_response and input_public_response are protocol objects. Everything else is isolated harness metadata.
interpretation.independence: Reset each case. Steps in a case are sequential at explicit nondecreasing synthetic clocks; no wall-clock wait.
interpretation.accepted_state: Setup arranges authoritative accepted history without sending. Repeated submit is a replay read, not another submit attempt.
interpretation.ownership: A fake trusted same-executor bridge supplies positive proof only where stated. No PID/nonce/time/lock probe is proof. No ownership metadata appears in protocol.
interpretation.ids: Invented deterministic 32-hex IDs and opaque fake artifact/profile hashes. Implementations may bijectively bind allocations, preserving all identity/revision comparisons.
interpretation.registry: Inject two isolated fake devices receipt-fx-a/b with in-memory dependencies and no addresses, sockets or discovery.
interpretation.serialization: Serialize each example as one strict UTF-8 JSON line ending in a single LF. Byte counts include that LF.
interpretation.negative_layers: wire_validation tests message consistency; trusted_projection/history/owner cases may be well-shaped but must not be emitted for the arranged facts. Do not claim a stateless parser can verify durable history or liveness.
interpretation.recovery: Outer ok is successful retrieval only; render original_state/reason/data. Read-only recovery never performs exclusive ownership/recovery or resends.
interpretation.facts: Compare every durable_rows key byte-for-byte with projected rows. allowed_actions is the envelope permission ceiling, not a durable fact.
interpretation.transport: All counters are per step and must stay zero. Arranged past rows may describe transmitted or observed paper but have no real I/O or real observation behind them.
interpretation.ordered_events: Claim/outcome/observation timestamps describe an ordered sender; each next claim follows the prior transmission outcome. Accepted but untouched rows retain acceptance time, so row-array timestamps need not all increase. Explicit setup timelines are metadata, not new protocol events.
interpretation.display_expectations: Use case.expected_display for common expectations and step.expect.display for phase-specific values. U09 deliberately has no case-wide headline or sender-indicator default; its effective inner submit envelope decides both for each step.

supersedes.scope: Fixture examples only. The reviewed projection note V1 remains unchanged and controls V2.

changes: U13/U16 reorder complete accepted rows and private claim facts to in_flight then prepared; derived N25 is updated too.
U06 second claim follows first transmission; U12 tail stop follows first transmission. Their derived cases retain intentional rejection mutations.
The same ordered-time correction covers the all-transmitted U10 control and derived N08/N09: second claim at 4, second outcome at 5.
U09 direct/recovered proof-loss steps have Paper may have printed and no sender indicator; proven phases have Send in progress and the indicator.
No protocol fields, note text, frozen V4, accepted wording, existing shared fixtures or prior V1 examples are edited.
